expression.description:
The expression to match against workflow or job identifiers.
Example: "startsWith('asset-onboarding-export')"

primaryKeyPrefix.description:
The prefix used to retrieve the primary banner text key.
Example: "Reliability.Banner.ExportData.PrimaryText"

secondaryKeyPrefix.description:
The prefix used to retrieve the secondary banner text key.
Example: "Reliability.Banner.ExportData.SecondaryText"

showRunningStatusBanner.description: Whether to show the running status banner for the workflow.

title: Defines a mapping from a workflow expression to banner translation key prefixes.
name: WorkflowBannerTranslationEntry
